rule_outs: Dwelling 2 m from the best section
summary: Steep, narrow Tarcoola Street lane with houses at the kerb; nowhere to stop.
reasons: Narrow lane, no shoulder to pull off

drivers.seclusion: Homes sit 2-7 m from the kerb for most of the 157 m; the upper lane is tree-lined with a house at each side.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane between fences, trees and steep bank; a van would block it.
drivers.traffic: Quiet lane serving a few houses, with a No Stopping sign at the Esplanade end.
drivers.convention: Resident-permit 2P signs Mon-Fri 7am-6pm; a few cars parked in driveways only.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m along most of the stretch
No Stopping Any Time sign at the lower end
Signs say 2P resident permits excepted Mon-Fri 7am-6pm
Sandy Creek 114 m away; lowest point 18 m
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over most of the lane, shading from both sides.
